enemies.scanDescription: An indistinct presence waits at the edge of an unfamiliar encounter. Its silence gives little away.
A shape without a familiar story stands before the traveller. For a moment, the world seems reluctant to explain itself.
Something unrecognised occupies the quiet space ahead. Its stillness offers no invitation.
A strange outline interrupts the ordinary order of things. The surrounding silence makes it seem more deliberate.
An unfamiliar figure waits beyond the comfort of recognition. Nothing in its bearing suggests a wish to be understood.
A quiet presence has found a place outside the traveller's experience. The distance between them seems unusually difficult to measure.
A nameless silhouette keeps its own counsel. Even the briefest meeting can leave an unanswered question.
Something without a familiar likeness has entered the encounter. Its purpose remains as closed as its expression.
An unrecognised presence occupies the margin of the scene. The world has room for more stories than a traveller can name.
A mountain of living armour advances with the patience of a closing wound. Cities and armies are only obstacles between the Planet and what threatens it.
The desert has raised a sentinel of its own. Beneath the drifting sand, something vast keeps an unhurried watch over the trespasses of the surface.
An immense root of living armour breaks the desert's stillness. The creature beneath the sand reaches farther than its silhouette suggests.
In the lightless sea, an ancient guardian moves through the wreckage of human ambition. Even the ocean seems to make room for its passing.
A pillar of living armour carries the weight of an ancient purpose. What appears to be a limb has the terrible scale of a moving landscape.
A cold, unblinking aperture opens in the guardian's armour. The darkness of the deep offers no shelter from its attention.
Under the helmet is an ordinary soldier, taught to see every stranger as a possible disturbance. The uniform makes the orders easier to obey.
Years of training have turned a pack hunter's loyalty into another lock on a company door. It waits for the familiar voice that tells it whom to hate.
A small machine drifts through the machinery like a loose thought. Its lonely patrol continues long after anyone has remembered to ask for a report.
The company has given this foot soldier a weapon, a uniform, and a very short list of acceptable answers. Doubt finds little room beneath the visor.
A little watchman suspended in the company's steel arteries. It has no understanding of trespass, only a tireless willingness to announce it.
Built to clear a path, this heavy patrol unit has never learned to distinguish rubbish from rebellion. Its footsteps are the sound of an order being carried out.
A mechanical jailer squats amid the reactor's pipes and steam. Even in a place that consumes the Planet, the company insists on keeping a watchful tail.
In the unlit spaces below the streets, patient legs weave a kingdom of discarded things. A careless footfall may be the first announcement of supper.
A fixed weapon waits where a sentry might once have stood. Its silence is not restraint; it is merely the interval between orders.
A hungry mouth on restless legs, perfectly at home where the city throws away its unwanted things. Nothing stays abandoned for long beneath the plates.
A scavenger has found shelter in a shape that looks suspiciously like discarded machinery. In the slums, even the vermin learn to wear armour.
A pale little drifter makes its home in the city's damp forgotten places. Its languid movements suggest a life untouched by the hurry overhead.
A squat, ill-tempered creature rummages through the margins of human settlement. Its comical outline offers very little comfort at close quarters.
A wheezing machine carries a little of the city's poisoned sky wherever it goes. Even underground, the company has found a way to foul the air.
A soldier equipped for work the ordinary patrol would rather leave to someone else. Behind the specialist's composure lies the same unquestioning chain of command.
A sleek hunter prowls the city's neglected depths. There is nothing ceremonial about its interest in a wounded traveller.
An early answer to the company's favourite question: how much firepower can be left unattended? Its rough construction has outlived the caution of its designers.
An armoured demonstration of industrial confidence occupies the narrow way ahead. Its designers appear to have mistaken a larger gun for a complete argument.
The alleys have taught this thief to judge strangers by the weight of their pockets. A moment's hesitation is all the invitation required.
A borrowed swagger and a powerful employer have made this thug feel untouchable. Courage comes cheaply when someone else owns the consequences.
A backstreet bruiser who has mistaken another man's favour for a place in the world. The sneer is easier to maintain when the crowd looks frightened.
Something immense has made a den of the filth beneath the city. In that dark, foul kingdom, every intrusion is both insult and opportunity.
A skulking inhabitant of damp passages, equally comfortable in stagnant water and the shadows beside it. The city has given it an endless shoreline of drains.
A hard-shelled scavenger picks its way through the city's wet underworld. Its small domain is defended with the conviction of an emperor.
An ominous rider haunts the places where the city's unwanted dead are forgotten. The clatter of its passage sounds older than the rails beneath it.
A pale memory lingers among abandoned carriages. Whatever journey it began, no timetable now promises an end.
Small nocturnal creatures gather where the railway falls silent. Their busy movements give the deserted platforms a life of their own.
A winged scavenger threads the black spaces between derelict trains. Its kingdom begins where the lamps have stopped working.
A familiar silhouette waits among the ruins, offering the shape of shelter without its promise. In the slums, even a doorway may conceal an appetite.
A familiar silhouette waits among the ruins, offering the shape of shelter without its promise. In the slums, even a doorway may conceal an appetite.
A soldier borne above the ground by the company's machinery. From that borrowed height, the disorder below must seem very easy to put in its place.
A soldier borne above the ground by the company's machinery. From that borrowed height, the disorder below must seem very easy to put in its place.
A careless posture disguises a professional's attention. For all the languid insolence, there is nothing accidental about where he chooses to stand.
A prison of hard light closes around its captive. Its elegant geometry lends a disquieting neatness to an act of cruelty.
An officious sign stands where reason has long since given way to security policy. The warning is less a courtesy than the first stage of the trap.
A company's argument reduced to a barrel and a mechanism. No face looks back from behind the weapon.
A sealed instrument of enforcement waits in the industrial gloom. Its immaculate casing has never had to consider what lies at the other end.
A heavy security attachment promises a blunt answer to an unwelcome visitor. Everything about its construction favours certainty over subtlety.
A quiet part of a greater design waits beyond the obvious outline. Small things can lend a terrible completeness to what surrounds them.
A mobile tangle of blades patrols the company's polished corridors. Its elaborate movements lend an almost festive air to a very ugly purpose.
A young member of the company's celebrated fighting force carries its reputation into every encounter. The discipline is real, even if the legend belongs to someone else.
A cumbersome shell gives an ordinary soldier the silhouette of a siege engine. The person inside remains hidden behind the company's idea of strength.
A cumbersome shell gives an ordinary soldier the silhouette of a siege engine. The person inside remains hidden behind the company's idea of strength.
A cutting machine has been taught to pursue living prey. In its bright revolving edges, factory work and warfare become much the same occupation.
A soldier who prefers the reassuring distance of a thrown explosive. The company's corridors offer little space for anyone caught in the lesson.
A grotesque specimen travels in a vessel that makes no attempt to look merciful. The laboratory has preserved something without asking what it preserved it for.
An unnatural patrol creature inhabits the company's sterile interiors. Whatever life preceded its service has been buried beneath an institutional purpose.
A laboratory predator moves with the unease of something that should never have left its cage. The corridors have become a hunting enclosure.
A nightmare assembled under laboratory lights now stands beyond the reach of its keepers. The language of research offers little comfort in its presence.
A smaller horror gathers around the escaped specimen. Even this satellite life bears the unsettling signature of deliberate interference.
A great security engine guards the tower's heights. The city below is scarcely more distant to it than the people standing in its sights.
A hovering weapons platform hangs in the open air with the poise of a hunting insect. The company's reach does not end at the edge of the floor.
An heir stands amid the machinery of inheritance, immaculate and quite prepared to make his intentions understood. Power has seldom had to ask him to wait.
A trained companion keeps close to a master who rarely needs to repeat himself. Its alert stillness is the other half of his composure.
An unobtrusive presence keeps its place in the larger arrangement. Its silence is easily mistaken for absence.
A rolling fortress bears down on the road with no concern for its other travellers. The pursuit has become an industrial process.
A rider has made the open road a place for ambush rather than escape. The engine's roar announces a freedom with very little generosity in it.
A machine intended for orderly patrols has found a wider territory beyond the city. The open plains have done nothing to broaden its instructions.
A lean predator follows the well-worn routes of travellers across the grasslands. The scent of civilisation is simply another way to find a meal.
A furtive scavenger moves at the edge of the traveller's attention. Its slight frame seems built to fit through the spaces left by unwary people.
A lumbering beast crosses the grasslands with the confidence of great bulk. Its unhurried curiosity can be just as troublesome as another creature's hunger.
A small burrower keeps most of its life beneath the earth. Only a twitch of soil betrays the busy little world below the traveller's boots.
Something scarcely noticed belongs to the scene before the traveller. The smallest detail may still have a purpose of its own.
A root has taken a more wandering interest in the world above. It carries the look of something pulled from the soil before it was ready to leave.
A watchful plains bird stalks the grass with a hunter's measured steps. There is very little of the songbird in its appraisal of strangers.
The marsh conceals a living length that seems to go on beyond sight. The ripples arriving at the bank are only the beginning of its presence.
A dark little creature clings to the shadows of the wild places. Its furtive movements suggest an old and enduring dislike of company.
An armoured insect crosses the ground with mechanical patience. Its small, purposeful world offers no right of way to larger travellers.
A young winged hunter has claimed the cramped dark as its own. A glimpse of scales in the gloom hints at a lineage much grander than its present den.
A strange little creature snaps its way through the forest's busy undergrowth. Its ungainly outline belongs to a world less concerned with elegance than survival.
A great woodland bird watches over the forest floor with grave, almost scholarly attention. Its passing stirs the hush beneath the canopy.
A restless creature keeps to the darker reaches of the wilderness. Its shape is easier to remember than to make sense of.
A mounted raider turns the wild roads into an extension of a battlefield. Even its name sounds like something that has been improved without becoming wiser.
A small aerial hunter skims over broken ground. The freedom of the sky has given it an excellent view of anything left exposed below.
An unruly creature haunts the places where wilderness presses against human work. Its twitching energy gives even its brief pauses an air of interruption.
An immense shape has settled into the water like a bad dream that refuses to drift away. The harbour's ordinary scale seems to shrink around it.
A translucent enclosure wobbles in the air with its captive held inside. The softness of its outline belies the simple horror of having nowhere to breathe.
A watchful little presence studies the world with an unsettling intensity. It makes no distinction between curiosity and intrusion.
A uniformed defender stands between the visitor and the company's waterside interests. Salt air has not softened the orders brought down from above.
Something brought from beyond the Planet continues a journey no human map can explain. The familiar world seems briefly less certain in its presence.
A sealed, rounded creature guards a surprising abundance of life within. The wilderness has hidden a whole little procession inside one unassuming shape.
A smaller life has emerged from its parent's keeping. It carries the same secretive promise of something still waiting inside.
The last small link in an improbable living chain. Even at this scale, the creature seems determined to take up its allotted place in the world.
A patient coastal creature clings to the shore's restless boundary. Around it, surf and stone have been negotiating for longer than anyone remembers.
A curious shape moves through the wilds with the assurance of a creature that has never needed to explain itself. The silhouette is stranger than any crown it resembles.
A tiny airborne hunter hovers where larger creatures would hardly think to look. Its delicate appearance conceals an entirely practical appetite.
A swollen little wanderer drifts with an air of improbable contentment. The world has supplied it with no obvious reason to hurry.
A heavy reptilian hunter shoulders its way through the wild country. Its ancient-looking patience suggests that the land belonged to creatures like this long before the roads.
An ill-tempered bird surveys the ground with a reptile's cold attention. Its ungainly bearing does little to diminish the unease it inspires.
A small, furious ember has taken on a life of its own. It swells with the conviction that every insult deserves a spectacular reply.
A crouching hunter carries its purpose in the cruel shape of its forelimbs. Nothing in its patient approach suggests that it expects to go hungry.
Two expressions share a single unsettling presence. Each seems to be waiting for the other to reveal what it truly intends.
A roadside thief has made a profession of other people's journeys. To such an opportunist, a traveller is merely luggage that has not yet been opened.
A heavy machine intrudes upon the wilderness with all the subtlety of a factory floor. Dust and distance have failed to loosen its devotion to force.
The earth rises around a hunger that has spent its life beneath it. For this vast burrower, the surface is simply another layer of the feeding ground.
A ruined man stands among the ruins that have come to resemble him. Grief has narrowed the world until almost nothing remains outside its reach.
A small creature makes a living in the difficult spaces between larger lives. Its nervous determination lends the scrubland a little more movement.
An unsettling entertainer offers a smile that has outlived the joke. The invitation to play carries none of the warmth that ought to accompany it.
A restless winged creature beats a path through the warm air. The landscape below seems to exist chiefly as somewhere to land and find trouble.
A creature of borrowed shapes watches the open country with a predator's calm. Its mismatched outline feels strangely complete in the wilderness.
A broad-shouldered beast faces the world behind an imposing crest. Its territory is measured less in distance than in what it is willing to allow nearby.
A wild creature moves through the scrub with the assurance of long familiarity. To its eyes, passing travellers are the unusual inhabitants.
A tiny marsh dweller waits among the reeds with an almost inviting stillness. The pond's quieter inhabitants rarely reward careless familiarity.
A drifting creature lets the water and wind do much of its travelling. Its elaborate outline lends the coast an alien, ornamental beauty.
A bright blossom has found an unusually active way to defend its patch of earth. The promise of beauty ends where the roots begin to stir.
A bright blossom has found an unusually active way to defend its patch of earth. The promise of beauty ends where the roots begin to stir.
A bright blossom has found an unusually active way to defend its patch of earth. The promise of beauty ends where the roots begin to stir.
A restless little creature lives close to the ground and far from human concerns. What it lacks in grandeur, it makes up for in sheer insistence.
An oversized insect threads the undergrowth with a scavenger's single-minded patience. The wilderness has no shortage of small lives eager to become larger.
A massive war machine has imposed the straight lines of industry upon the wild ground. It carries the company's certainty that every problem can be driven over.
A careless posture disguises a professional's attention. For all the languid insolence, there is nothing accidental about where he chooses to stand.
A quiet professional lets his silence do the work of a threat. The restraint is deliberate; so is everything that follows it.
A quick-footed little scavenger darts through the dry ground. Its bright-eyed confidence is the product of having escaped a great many larger appetites.
A proud winged hunter surveys a country too broad for walls. Its shadow is a reminder that the sky has inhabitants as territorial as those below.
A heavy figure has taken on the stillness of the stone around it. Only its movement reveals that the landscape has decided to object.
A squat reptile watches the path with an unnervingly patient gaze. Its silence makes the surrounding scrub seem louder by comparison.
A traveller of the dry wastes has learned to thrive where a shoreline ought to be. The desert offers shelter only to those willing to become part of it.
An old grievance has found a shape in which to linger. The air around it feels less like a passageway than a memory refusing to open.
An elusive remnant moves where the light cannot quite follow. Its passage leaves the uneasy impression of someone stepping aside just out of sight.
A little wilderness creature occupies its corner of the world with fierce conviction. Size has done nothing to moderate its opinion of strangers.
A patient cave hunter waits among rock and shadow. The darkness is not a hiding place to it, but the ordinary light of home.
A wandering flame carries something more restless than ordinary heat. In the deep places, even light can feel like a refusal to let go.
An ancient sorrow has kept its vigil long after the living abandoned the argument. The darkness around it has become a kingdom of unfinished endings.
A mountain hunter follows the cold paths between stone and scrub. Its wary movements belong to a land that offers little room for mistakes.
A scavenging bird circles the rough country with patient, practical interest. Nothing lost upon the mountainside remains private for long.
A strange hunter claims the mountains' narrow passages. The rocks have made a secret of its movements, but not of its appetite.
A winged scavenger wheels above a country of steep shadows. The cliffs offer it a thousand places from which to wait.
A cap of improbable colour rises from the forest's damp floor. The quiet industry beneath it has little need of sunlight or permission.
A wavering presence unsettles the familiar shapes of the wilderness. Looking directly at it does surprisingly little to settle the matter.
An absurd expression hangs in the air where no welcoming face should be. Its fixed amusement makes the surrounding silence feel like an audience.
A peculiar figure keeps the company of dust and abandoned rooms. Its composed stillness seems to belong to a household whose rules nobody remembers.
A small nocturnal hunter stitches the darkness with quick, economical wings. The deserted halls are far less empty to it than they appear to visitors.
An ungainly swordsman haunts the old mansion with the air of a performance interrupted. The abandoned rooms have made a patient audience.
An old fastening has become part of something that refuses to stay still. Rust and neglect have not persuaded it to loosen its hold.
One half of an uneasy companionship wears a face that cannot quite conceal its misery. Even its silence seems to be an argument.
One half of a shared nightmare gives its distress an almost gleeful shape. The expression is no assurance of happiness.
Two irreconcilable moods have been obliged to share a single existence. Their unhappy conversation has no need of words.
A forgotten experiment waits behind the mansion's closed history. Its unfinished shape suggests a question the laboratory never learned to answer.
A forgotten experiment waits behind the mansion's closed history. Its unfinished shape suggests a question the laboratory never learned to answer.
A forgotten experiment waits behind the mansion's closed history. Its unfinished shape suggests a question the laboratory never learned to answer.
A great scaled hunter has made the mountain country its inheritance. The narrow paths feel newly fragile beneath its attention.
A machine cuts through the air with an urgency that belongs to its instructions. The quiet of the mountains is only another thing for it to disturb.
A curious pair of forms shares a single uneasy purpose. The creature's outline suggests that one mind was never quite enough.
An enormous bird claims the upper air with effortless authority. Far below, travellers pass through the moving border of its shadow.
A furtive creature keeps to the crags and broken earth. The mountains have shaped its life into a succession of narrow opportunities.
A restless inhabitant of the wild heights gives voice to a country of wind and stone. Even before it is seen, the stillness around it has begun to change.
An ancient-looking guardian occupies the mountain passage like a living seal. Whatever the road once promised, it now requires this creature's consent.
A company executive has brought his appetites and his bluster into a situation poorly suited to either. His confidence seems determined to survive every piece of evidence against it.
A hidden part of the encounter waits outside the familiar shapes of its inhabitants. Not every presence announces itself.
An overlooked detail completes an unfamiliar whole. The eye finds little to hold, but the silence is not quite empty.
A great bird rides the unsettled sky as though the weather were a private road. The clouds seem less lonely in its company.
A patch of vegetation has abandoned the gentle expectations people place upon growing things. Every rustle sounds a little too deliberate.
A strange creature wears an outline of hard angles and ill intentions. The rough country has little use for a softer design.
An oversized insect works its way through a world of stems and stone. Its unlikely shape is perfectly ordinary to the life around it.
A wilderness hunter carries a curious balance of weight and movement. Its restless tail seems forever engaged in a conversation with the ground.
An old, armoured wanderer carries its shelter through the world. The patient weight of its passage makes a road seem like a temporary arrangement.
A trained fighter carries the company's discipline into rough country. Even far from the parade ground, the habits of formation remain.
A skulking creature has made a living at the edge of travellers' routes. Its furtive patience is the sort that survives long after a grander hunter has gone hungry.
A highland bird moves through the thin air with solemn authority. The cliffs beneath it seem built as much for wings as for stone.
An odd little inhabitant of the wild country regards the path as its own. Its unlikely appearance has not prevented it from finding a place to thrive.
A huge flying beast has been pressed into another creature's quarrel. Its restless wings make an enclosure of the open air.
A watchful guardian stands upon the first steps of a proud tradition. Ceremony has given its strange form a place and a purpose.
A towering guardian waits with the composure of a test that has been given many times. The visitor's confidence is merely the latest thing to arrive.
An austere guardian measures every challenger with a gaze that seems older than the room. Patience is part of the examination.
A formidable keeper stands between ambition and the next flight of stairs. The silence leaves the challenger to supply their own doubts.
A nation's old pride takes on a many-sided presence. Beneath the spectacle lies a father's resolve and a ruler's unfinished duty.
A low-slung hunter slips through the places where travellers seldom look. Its life has been shaped by the generous shelter beneath larger things.
A strange little creature claims a place among the rocks and scrub. The world has never required its inhabitants to explain their outlines.
A great beast advances behind an imposing pair of natural weapons. Its patient tread gives the wilderness the air of being carefully inspected.
A winged hunter lets the currents carry it above the rough ground. Its shadow arrives long before its purpose becomes clear.
A little marsh dweller sits with regal indifference in its damp kingdom. The still water around it conceals a remarkably busy life.
An uncanny figure offers a suggestion of grace in a place that offers little welcome. The invitation in its bearing is difficult to trust.
A hulking sentinel seems built for the narrow passage it occupies. Whatever lies beyond has acquired a formidable doorkeeper.
A winged relic of a much older wilderness keeps its place among forgotten stones. The passing of human ages has scarcely troubled its domain.
A great scaled guardian occupies the old halls with the assurance of a rightful heir. The stone around it seems to have learned to keep its distance.
A cluster of watchful little lives peers from the gloom. The darkness has furnished its own uneasy constellation.
An ancient threshold has found a terrible way to refuse passage. The stone itself seems unwilling to let the travellers continue.
A presence from beyond the familiar world rises once more into an unwilling shape. Every encounter feels less like a return than another stage of an inexorable arrival.
A massive wilderness beast moves with the calm of a creature that has seldom been challenged. Its bulk makes the open ground feel unexpectedly crowded.
A furtive little mischief-maker regards the traveller's plans as an invitation. Its satisfaction seems to come from leaving the world less orderly than it found it.
A quiet shape occupies the edge of a larger mystery. The traveller has arrived too briefly to learn its story.
An ungainly remnant wanders where life and decay have lost their clear boundary. The earth seems reluctant to take it back.
A strange figure moves through the wilds with a rhythm of its own. The performance has neither a visible audience nor any apparent wish to end.
A hard-bitten fighter watches the road with the patience of long service. The uniform seems to have become a second skin.
A small creature regards the world as a succession of things that might fit inside it. Its ambition is considerably larger than its outline.
A coastal scavenger keeps close to rock and tide. The restless shore has furnished it with both a shelter and a hunting ground.
A heavy shape has risen out of the frozen country as though the winter had grown tired of waiting. Its measured steps disturb a very old silence.
A sharp-edged hunter makes a hard living in the cold wilderness. The land has rewarded a design with little room for softness.
A great cold-country beast shoulders its way across the frozen ground. Its slow presence gives the wind another obstacle to work around.
A creature of the cold wastes wears the harshness of its home in every line. Even at rest it seems to be enduring a weather of its own.
A small wanderer crosses the rough ground in impatient bounds. The world appears to offer it nothing worth approaching slowly.
A solitary figure inhabits the white distances with an unsettling ease. The wilderness seems less empty when it turns to look back.
A lean hunter follows the cold trails with single-minded attention. The long winter has made patience a practical necessity.
A strange life stirs among the snow and stone. Its uninviting shape belongs to a country that has never promised comfort.
An unassuming presence keeps company with something much easier to notice. Obscurity has a patience all its own.
A small, uncertain outline belongs to the encounter without explaining how. The world does not always offer a name before demanding attention.
A great rootless growth drags the smell of spoiled gardens through the wild. The world seems to have let something rot for far too long.
A great reptile keeps watch in a land of deep cold and ancient silence. The snow around its resting place seems older than any road.
A long winter has gathered itself into a hanging blade. The cavern holds its breath beneath the weight of it.
A rough fighter has brought a bruiser's confidence to the cold country. The wilderness offers a rather larger audience than the street.
A many-limbed hunter waits against the mountain stone. Its stillness makes it seem less an inhabitant of the cavern than a particularly cruel part of it.
A peculiar mountain creature watches the narrow routes through the rock. In such a place, even a modest appetite can become a traveller's problem.
A disembodied visage hangs in the gloom with an expression too intent to be lifeless. The old passages have acquired an unwelcome witness.
An uncanny shape keeps its own counsel in the mountain dark. Its silence makes the distance to daylight feel a little longer.
A giant of the high country moves with the confidence of great strength. The old stones seem almost companionable beside it.
An angry little sphere hangs in the air like the last moment before a disaster. Its entire existence seems directed toward making that moment count.
A wiry troublemaker haunts the places where travellers would prefer an uneventful passage. Mischief seems less a habit than its chosen occupation.
A winged hunter threads the mountain air between hard stone and empty space. Its resting places are beyond the comfort of most travellers.
An unsettling figure has taken on the stillness of an ornament. Time has not made it harmless, only easier to mistake for something that is.
One watchful head shares a body with a mind it can never quite escape. The creature's divided attention feels less like confusion than an old quarrel.
A second hungry intelligence turns above the same great frame. Whatever agreement binds the pair has made no provision for visitors.
A broad-winged creature inhabits the draughts and ledges of the old passages. The air remembers its presence long after it has passed.
A mounted hunter has made an alliance with a creature born for the heights. Together they lend the narrow paths the scale of a battlefield.
An armoured creature waits with the peculiar stillness of a closed container. Its shape invites questions that proximity is unlikely to answer kindly.
A tiny keeper of the dark advances with a lantern and an untroubled sense of purpose. The measured footsteps leave an extraordinary amount of time to become afraid.
An alien will takes shape again among the remnants of an older world. Even here, in a place full of endings, it seems intent on beginning something.
A war machine turns the language of chance into another instrument of control. Its mechanisms offer the appearance of a game without the courtesy of consent.
An unassuming support carries a more terrible design above it. Even the smallest part of a machine can have an uncompromising purpose.
A seasoned member of the company's elite carries the assurance of hard-earned standing. The polished reputation is supported by a life spent practising its demands.
A mobile arsenal moves through the narrow industrial passages with utter indifference to their inhabitants. The company's intentions have seldom looked so plainly mechanical.
A quick-moving machine weaves through the space available to it. Its restless course lends an ugly purpose an almost sporting appearance.
A heavy security mechanism has made a weapon of an ordinary working motion. The machinery of labour adapts all too easily to violence.
The upper section of an immense cutting machine hangs over the passage. Its separation from the rest has done nothing to soften its purpose.
A lower assembly anchors the machine's cruel working shape. The confined floor leaves very little room outside its reach.
An unseen hand has arranged a collection of weapons into a single watchful presence. The empty spaces between its parts offer no real reassurance.
A compact weapon answers the company's need for immediate obedience. The mechanism has no opinion of the orders it receives.
A fixed weapon waits where a sentry might once have stood. Its silence is not restraint; it is merely the interval between orders.
A lost vessel drifts through a sea that no longer seems entirely made of water. Whatever crew it remembers has left no hand upon the wheel.
An armoured machine bears the closed, purposeful outline of a vessel at war. Its designers have carried the company's ambitions into another environment.
A strange creature has made a home in the world below the surface. The deep has supplied it with a privacy the visitor is now disturbing.
A sailor carries out the company's business in a world enclosed by steel. Beneath the surface, even an ordinary order can feel final.
An officer stands at the point where responsibility becomes command. In the close confines of service, a steady voice is another form of armour.
A company soldier serves where the sea presses against every wall. The uniform's familiar authority is a small comfort in so unfamiliar a world.
Long service has worn away the novelty of the uniform without loosening its hold. The orders may change, but the habit of obedience endures.
A heavily equipped fighter brings the company's insistence upon control into close quarters. The armour gives little hint of the person carrying it.
A machine waits at the edge of the company's most jealously kept spaces. Vigilance has been reduced to a design that never needs to sleep.
A weapon assembly turns in concert with the machine that carries it. Its small movements suggest a purpose constantly being renewed.
A second watchful attachment completes the machine's threatening symmetry. There is something deeply impersonal about such well-organised attention.
A walking platform has been given the plain duty of bringing a weapon closer. Its ponderous steps make the intention difficult to misunderstand.
A machine built to lift and move has been made to handle living intruders instead. Its great arms preserve the workman's motions while abandoning the workman's restraint.
A great limb reaches out from a larger purpose. Its grasp gives the surrounding space the uneasy scale of something already enclosed.
A second limb waits beside the first, lending the creature's outline an oppressive completeness. Even at rest, the reach is difficult to ignore.
A strange wilderness creature follows a life that has little intersection with human roads. The meeting is no more welcome from its side.
A dark shape haunts the rough ground with a hunter's wary patience. Its forbidding appearance is a poor substitute for understanding what it wants.
A long-legged bird makes its measured way through the wild country. The earth seems to interest it chiefly as something to search carefully.
A great mass of unruly growth has learned to wander beyond its roots. The surrounding air carries the stale perfume of a garden left to its worst intentions.
A peculiar creature moves through places where the air has long ceased to be pleasant. It appears entirely comfortable with what others struggle to endure.
A hardened fighter carries the solitude of a hunter into the company's ranks. The uniform has not quite concealed the old instincts beneath it.
A high-mounted weapon surveys the ground with a predator's borrowed perspective. Its builders have given it reach without ever needing to give it wings.
A long aquatic hunter slips through the water with an economy that makes great size seem effortless. The surface offers only the briefest account of its passage.
A small, odd creature has found its place at the edge of a much larger world. Its restless curiosity is not necessarily a welcome.
A rough little hunter moves with the energy of a quarrel looking for somewhere to happen. The wilderness provides no shortage of opportunities.
Something unfamiliar has made its home among the deep's forgotten remains. The lack of a familiar outline feels less like mystery than a quiet warning.
An uncanny inhabitant of the submerged dark moves beyond the comfort of familiar categories. The deep seems content to keep its history to itself.
A second strange life has settled into the silence below. Whatever shaped it left few clues that a surface traveller would recognise.
A careless posture disguises a professional's attention. For all the languid insolence, there is nothing accidental about where he chooses to stand.
A quiet professional lets his silence do the work of a threat. The restraint is deliberate; so is everything that follows it.
A proud winged beast keeps its place between the high air and the rough earth. Both seem equally its inheritance.
A seasoned predator follows the roads people leave through the wild. Its attention gives the impression of a hunt already well under way.
